nodes.label: Stock Research App PWA Icon (512px)
nodes.description: 512x512 PWA app icon with a rounded-square shape. Features a purple-to-violet gradient background (deep blue-purple on top-left fading to medium purple on bottom-right). The foreground graphic combines two visual motifs: a white/light-lavender EKG/heartbeat pulse waveform on the left side, which seamlessly transitions into an upward-trending stock chart line on the right side. The stock chart line terminates at the upper-right with a green chevron/arrow accent, suggesting upward market momentum. The design merges health/vitality symbolism (heartbeat) with financial growth (stock chart), communicating real-time market monitoring. Brand identity is modern, clean, and finance-tech oriented.
